title: Doing it now: your words appear in the log the instant you send them

text: Two layers. Today: the assistant's first act on every prompt becomes one command that needs no thinking, which puts your exact words in this log and in my inbox before it starts answering. Soon: the hook a minion is already building does the same thing mechanically at the moment you press send, with no model involved at all, so it is instant. Your words will show as yours, marked differently from mine.
